Recheck current stack status last within the nine preflight reads. A mismatch, no historical same-UUID stable proof, or an expired fact/start time prohibits submission.

Require UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE and operation correlation. If submission ACK was unknown, report independently observed state separately; do not invent attribution or replay the request.

Record the observed DisableRollback field without assuming RollbackStack resets it. This does not verify actual old rules, API health, DNS or current Cell state.
If any retained condition fails, do not accept or continue to a new change set; record the actual partial state without automatic stop, compensation, permissions edits or cleanup.
risks: This is a whole-tenant-stack rollback, not a three-rule Change Set preview. The four retained resources are acceptance requirements, not a technical fence preventing provider reconciliation.

RollbackStack deletes a stack if there is no last known stable state. Same-UUID CREATE_COMPLETE evidence and current failed-operation checks are mandatory; missing proof is a no-go, not permission to try.

Old rule/listener entities were missing before B. Rollback can fail on that drift, may remove newly created resources, and does not guarantee old rules or API availability. RetainExceptOnCreate=false does not prohibit all provider deletion.

The template still declares DesiredCount=1 while the last observed service is 0. Provider rollback may start/reconcile tasks and trigger managed Secret injection, runtime database activity including startup writes, and compute charges even with zero direct ECS/Secret/SQL calls. Business-state preservation cannot be guaranteed. No automatic stop is authorized if counts change.
Metadata checks and the request are not a cross-service CAS. Concurrent actors or existing cleanup mechanisms can change resources; this scope does not inspect or alter those mechanisms.

AWS Login refresh, Source RollbackStack/PassRole permissions or SCP checks may fail. Read success is not write permission proof; failure or unknown submission is not permission for a retry or IAM expansion.
Provider/network logs, credential use in memory and existing billable resources remain. ALB may continue charging; no resource expiry, automatic cleanup or 50 USD hard cap is installed.

NoEcho checks compare masked metadata, not secret values. Only the exact account APIs are permitted; original template body is compared in memory and is not persisted or published. Existing private metadata evidence and new audit files are used locally.
New facts expire at their original five-hour endpoint; the 15-minute latest-start margin is not a resource lease. No operation/claim/TTL or old approval is extended.
implementationBoundary: Use the existing AWS CLI and private evidence recorder for this exact approved request and checks; no new runtime framework, fallback write or API operation is authorized.
next: Only after the user approves this new canonical manifest and whole-stack/runtime/provider risks, perform the single rollback and independent checks. Completion only restores reviewed CFN control state; later corrected B creation/execution, DNS and image updates remain separately reviewed.
